candidates.title: Walking
candidates.definition: Human locomotion on foot by sequential steps. Explicitly recognized running and stair movement are treated as separate actions.

candidates.title: Walking Duration
candidates.definition: Duration of a walking episode under the defined time contract. If it is unknown whether stops are included, that uncertainty is preserved.

candidates.title: Step Count
candidates.definition: Number of steps taken within one walking episode.

candidates.title: Stair ascent
candidates.definition: A person ascending stairs as a single physical activity episode. This object is used for parameters describing the whole ascent episode, including its duration.

candidates.title: Sleep
candidates.definition: A recurring physiological state characterized by reduced responsiveness to the environment and organized sleep architecture, supporting recovery and regulation of organism functions.

candidates.title: Night sleep
candidates.definition: A sleep episode that constitutes the person's principal sleep period associated with the night. It is not identified from duration alone; explicit user or device labeling, timing and context may be used.

candidates.title: Night sleep duration
candidates.definition: Total duration of a night-sleep episode under the selected measurement contract. If the source reports time asleep rather than time in bed, that source meaning is preserved.

candidates.title: REM sleep duration
candidates.definition: Duration within a night-sleep episode classified by the reporting source or measurement method as REM sleep. The source method and its uncertainty are preserved.

candidates.title: Deep sleep duration
candidates.definition: Duration within a night-sleep episode classified by the reporting source or measurement method as deep sleep. The source method and its uncertainty are preserved rather than assuming equivalence between devices.

candidates.title: Light sleep duration
candidates.definition: Duration within a night-sleep episode classified by the reporting source or measurement method as light sleep. The source method and its uncertainty are preserved rather than assuming equivalence between devices.

candidates.title: Awakening count
candidates.definition: Number of awakening episodes reported or detected within a night-sleep episode under the source's detection rules. Differences in source methods and detection thresholds are preserved.

candidates.title: Coffee consumption
candidates.definition: An event or process in which a person consumes coffee as a beverage. The number of cups or servings consumed may be stored as a separate fact using the Count parameter. Caffeine dose is not inferred without an explicit value or verified source.

candidates.title: Dietary supplement intake
candidates.definition: Human actions involving the intake of dietary supplements.

candidates.title: Physical activity
candidates.definition: Human activity involving bodily movement, musculoskeletal work, and energy expenditure.

candidates.title: Sleep state
candidates.definition: A functional state describing whether and how a person or organism is sleeping during a defined interval. Specific measured aspects are represented by facts linked to more specific observation objects.

candidates.title: Human activity
candidates.definition: Actions and activities performed by a human as an acting agent.

candidates.title: Human organism
candidates.definition: The human biological system as a whole, including organs, organ systems, tissues, and other structural parts.

candidates.title: Pull-up on a horizontal bar
candidates.definition: A strength exercise performed while hanging from a horizontal bar, in which a person raises the body using upper-body musculature and then lowers it under control.
